facts.fact: At the Starlink launch on 27 July 2026 the Minister of Health described the connectivity as part of the Ministry's plan to move from paper-based patient records to a digital health system; no electronic record system is named and no tier is specified.

systems.tiers: 300 government health facilities across Sierra Leone; launched at the Julius Maada Bio Paediatric Centre of Excellence, Freetown

note: Electronic health reporting and disease monitoring are named only as uses the connection will support; no reporting system is named.
